== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab (Japanese)|Hoth: Echo Med Lab]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/148375106/Npz9pQ_3E0mHXU0li1O5rQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 82917279.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e374c83c50b971f39d3b64fd749bc7ebcd770cc8e3fbb9dbcd7c05eac72b652b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
